key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Cauline leaves divided into narrow linear to filiform lobes.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Usually 8 yellow to golden-yellow rays; disc corollas red-brown or yellow with red-brown nerves.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: Involucre subtended by a calyculus of 7–8+ narrow bractlets.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: threadlike leaf lobes; 8 yellow rays; red-brown/yellow disc; slender greenthread habit
